reviews.text: I highly recommend Houck Pest Control for anyone who needs a pest inspection or pest control service. Houck completed the wood destroying insect (WDI) inspection required for my VA cash-out refinance today, and the entire experience was excellent from start...
reviews.author: Kris Q.

reviews.text: Dave and Trevor have worked on mice infestation, ground hog removal, ant control, and removal of a giant wasp nest on my property. Both men are very professional, knowledgeable, thorough, and good at explaining things. Fees are very reasonable.
